Christopher Loh (MD & CEO) | products = | brands = | services = | owner = U Ne Aung | website = {{URL|www.uab.com.mm/}} | assets = [[Myanmar kyat|Ks.]]1819.4 billion{{cite web |title=Financial Statements |url=https://www.uab.com.mm/Financial_Statements_FY_2022.pdf |website=www.uab.com.mm |access-date=2 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230417170901/https://www.uab.com.mm/Financial_Statements_FY_2022.pdf |archive-date=April 17, 2023 |language=en |date=2022 |url-status=live}} ({{USD|866 million}}) | assets_year = 2021-22 }} '''uab''' (formerly known as United Amara Bank) is a [[Private equity|private]] commercial bank in [[Myanmar]]. == History == uab was one of 4 private banks to commence operations in August 2010, the first new financial institutions in the country since the establishment of [[Innwa Bank]] in 1997.{{cite book|last=Cheesman|first=Nick|title=Myanmar's Transition: Openings, Obstacles, and Opportunities|author2=Skidmore|first2=Monique|author3=Wilson|first3=Trevor|date=2012|publisher=Institute of Southeast Asian Studies|pages=147|author-link2=Monique Skidmore}}{{Cite web |last=Mike |date=2022-08-18 |title=UK’s Euromoney Urged to Revoke Its Award to Myanmar Crony Bank UAB |url=https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/uks-euromoney-urged-to-revoke-its-award-to-myanmar-crony-bank-uab.html |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=The Irrawaddy |language=en-US}} uab bank has a network of over 79 branches in 53 townships across Myanmar. Christopher Loh is the [[CEO]] of the bank. The bank is majority owned by Ne Aung, the son of [[Aung Thaung]], who has been blacklisted by the [[United States Treasury]] on 31 October 2014{{cite news|url=http://www.mmtimes.com/index.php/business/12446-ghosts-of-2003-crisis-haunt-banks.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150628001559/http://www.mmtimes.com/index.php/business/12446-ghosts-of-2003-crisis-haunt-banks.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=June 28, 2015|title=Ghosts of 2003 crisis haunt banks|last=Aye Thida Kyaw|date=8 December 2014|work=Myanmar Times|access-date=8 February 2015}} for his membership in the country's ruling military junta, the [[State Peace and Development Council]] and his attempts to undermine [[Burma]]'s economic and political reforms.{{Cite web |title=Myanmar: City publisher Euromoney gave 'best bank' award to a lender linked to military regime — Finance Uncovered |url=https://financeuncovered.org/stories/euromoney-best-bank-award-myanmar |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=financeuncovered.org |language=en}}{{cite 16, 2014|title=United Amara frets bank run as owner’s father blacklisted|last=Aye Thida Kyaw|date=10 November 2014|work=Myanmar Times|access-date=8 February 2015}} {{cite news|url=http://www.mizzima.com/business/property/item/14466-blacklisted-mp-not-linked-to-united-amara-bank-only-son/14466-blacklisted-mp-not-linked-to-united-amara-bank-only-son|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141111041707/http://mizzima.com/business/property/item/14466-blacklisted-mp-not-linked-to-united-amara-bank-only-son/14466-blacklisted-mp-not-linked-to-united-amara-bank-only-son|url-status=dead|archive-date=November 11, 2014|title=NOV Blacklisted MP ‘not linked to United Amara Bank,’ only son|last=Thiha Ko Ko|date=5 November 2014|work=Mizzima|access-date=8 February 2015}} In 2013, UAB Bank started using Pumori Banking Software, developed by Mercantile Office Systems, Kathmandu Nepal. In 2016, uab bank and [[Asian Development Bank]] signed a trade finance agreement to support businesses in Myanmar.{{Cite web |last=Chan |first=Aye |date=2016-09-15 |title=United Amara and Asian Development Bank Sign Trade Finance Agreement |url=https://www.myanmarinsider.com/united-amara-and-asian-development-bank-sign-trade-finance-agreement/ |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=Myanmar Insider |language=en-US}} In 2017, uab bank launched [[Visa Inc.|Visa]]-branded credit cards in Myanmar to cater to the demand for electronic payments in the country.{{Cite web |last=bkumar1 |date=2017-09-15 |title=United Amara Bank launches Visa-branded credit cards in Myanmar |url=https://www.electronicpaymentsinternational.com/news/united-amara-bank-launches-visa-branded-credit-cards-in-myanmar/ |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=Electronic Payments International |language=en-US}} uab bank and Global Star Co. Ltd. partnered with [[Huawei]] to distribute solar energy products in Myanmar.{{Cite web |last=Irrawaddy |first=The |date=2023-03-07 |title=Myanmar Junta Crony’s Firm Named Local Distributor for Huawei Solar Energy Products |url=https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/myanmar-junta-cronys-firm-named-local-distributor-for-huawei-solar-energy-products.html |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=The Irrawaddy |language=en-US}} == Awards and nominations == [[Global Banking & Finance Awards]] gave uab bank, ''Best Banking CEO Myanmar'' award in 2019.{{Cite web |title=GLOBAL BANKING & FINANCE AWARDS® – 2019 – Award Winners {{!}} Global Banking & Finance Review |url=https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/global-banking-finance-awards-2019-award-winners/ |access-date=2023-04-04 |language=en-GB}} In 2022, uab bank was given ''Best bank in Myanmar'' award by [[Euromoney|The Euromoney Awards for Excellence]].{{Cite web |date=2022-07-14 |title=Awards for Excellence 2022: Best bank in Myanmar – uab |url=https://www.euromoney.com/article/2ack76zq6ehfr49rdi7ls/awards/awards-for-excellence/awards-for-excellence-2022-best-bank-in-myanmar-uab |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=Euromoney |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2022-07-17 |title=Myanmar's best bank for ESG 2022: uab bank |url=https://www.asiamoney.com/article/27i6gralrq1bhg3whzzls/awards/best-bank-awards/myanmars-best-bank-for-esg-2022-uab-bank |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=Asiamoney |language=en |archive-date=2023-04-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230404171526/https://www.asiamoney.com/article/27i6gralrq1bhg3whzzls/awards/best-bank-awards/myanmars-best-bank-for-esg-2022-uab-bank |url-status=dead }} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [https://www.uab.com.mm/ Official Website] {{Portal|Banks}} [[Category:Banks of Myanmar]] [[Category:Banks established in 2010]] [[Category:2010 establishments in Myanmar]] [[Category:Entities related to Myanmar sanctions]]
